_comment: Shared by pytest (tests/test_listen_paragraphs_shared.py) and vitest (ui/src/listen/textScript.test.ts): the chapter text -> paragraphs rule of textScript.ts (splitParagraphs after withoutLines, the skip lines of the listener) and its Python port abook/readaloud/paragraphs.py (used by the desktop audiobook export) - an exported chapter must be cut into the very paragraphs the player reads, or the clips already made do not match. Change one side, change the others and this file.
